# Seasonal Charms

The charm map: long labels, a linked label and three coloured paths.

```text-mapper
0101 green trees "Moss Germinations"
0201 light-green grass "Fog Lantern"
0102 water "Polish&Transplant"
0202 dark-green fir-forest "Unpredictable"
0301 light-soil hill "Rootbinder|Mend a Bone"
0302 grey mountains "Under the Brambles"
0402 light-grey "Fog Mantle"
0101-0201-0301 green-path
0102-0202-0302 pink-path
0201-0302-0402 orange-path
green-path path attributes stroke="green" stroke-width="6" fill="none"
pink-path path attributes stroke="hotpink" stroke-width="6" fill="none"
orange-path path attributes stroke="orange" stroke-width="6" fill="none"
```
